description: Dated exchange-notice evidence for the 104 Task AH unique-name candidates; not a runnable identity, corporate-action or eligibility ledger.

semantics.code: Explicit common-share short code in a dated additional/SPAC-disappearance listing body. An opaque issuer_id is never converted into a code.
semantics.listed_on: Notice listing date, not legal merger effect or assumed tradability.
semantics.notice_evidence_available_on: Latest publication day among selected documents, including name-changing corrections; no intraday availability claim.
semantics.known_on: Unassigned. This acquisition does not build historical classification or lookback intervals.
semantics.candidate_isin: The input manifest retains current candidate ISINs. Only SPAC-disappearance notices independently verify the operating-company ISIN.
semantics.missing_old_spac_code: A disappearing SPAC name alone does not certify its old stock code or exchange ratio.
